test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters M, N, O, P, Q and R are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure below. Find the letter on the face opposite to O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb64cc65e96d0332a1eeb16600c7a8aa6e561bcd3f8a9e64f9d8473c189b0e5b.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'O', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28a4d1806e162cc930de5df21e479f9e9934a639d424c48566ffcc0f87bfb56c.png] 

From both dices, O is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

M is opposite to P.

N is opposite to Q.

So, R will be opposite to O.

Hence, the correct answer is "R".
